# `/recommendations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /recommendations/v1/request

`getRecommendationsV1` — Returns recommendation based on object — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

The getRecommendations API returns recommendations based on the requested object. The recommendations are invoked by IdentityIQ and IdentityNow plug-ins that retrieve recommendations based on the performed calculations.

- Scopes: iai:decisions:manage
- User levels: Any
- Body (application/json): recommendationrequestdto
- Returns 200: recommendationresponsedto

### GET /recommendations/v1/config

`getRecommendationsConfigV1` — Get certification recommendation config values — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Retrieves configuration attributes used by certification recommendations.

- Scopes: iai:configuration:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: recommendationconfigdto

### PUT /recommendations/v1/config

`updateRecommendationsConfigV1` — Update certification recommendation config values — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Updates configuration attributes used by certification recommendations.

- Scopes: iai:configuration:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): recommendationconfigdto
- Returns 200: recommendationconfigdto
